fn:hashPassword.cost: one PBKDF2-SHA256 run with the given iterations (10,000 to 1,000,000); salt 16 to 64 bytes.
fn:hashPassword.failure: AuthError/Range (salt length or iterations out of range).

fn:needsRehash.failure: none; malformed input or an unknown algorithm returns true.

fn:signToken.cost: one HMAC-SHA256 over the token head; key at least 16 bytes, payload at most 4096 bytes.
fn:signToken.failure: AuthError/Range (key shorter than 16 bytes or payload longer than 4096 bytes).

fn:verifyCsrf.cost: one HMAC-SHA256 and a constant-time comparison.
fn:verifyCsrf.failure: none; a wrong token, wrong session or unusable key returns false.

fn:verifyPassword.cost: one PBKDF2-SHA256 run with the iterations stored in the hash (1 to 1,000,000).
fn:verifyPassword.failure: none; malformed input, an unknown algorithm or a wrong password all return false.

fn:verifyToken.cost: one HMAC-SHA256 over the token head; the signature is checked before the payload is returned.
fn:verifyToken.failure: AuthError/BadSignature (signature mismatch, or key shorter than 16 bytes), Expired (now is at or after expiresAt), Malformed (wrong shape or undecodable parts).
